name: Three financial statements
summary: Income statement, balance sheet and cash flow statement, linked through net income, cash and retained earnings.

name: Accrual accounting
summary: Revenue and expenses are recognised when earned or incurred, not when cash moves.

name: Non-cash charges
summary: Expenses such as D&A and stock-based compensation that reduce net income without using cash.

name: Enterprise value
summary: Value of the core operations to all capital providers: equity value plus net debt and other claims.

name: Equity value
summary: Value attributable to shareholders only: diluted shares outstanding × share price.

name: Net debt
summary: Total debt less cash and cash equivalents.

name: Trading comparables
summary: Valuation from multiples of similar listed companies.

name: Precedent transactions
summary: Valuation from multiples paid in past acquisitions of similar companies; includes a control premium.

name: Discounted cash flow
summary: Intrinsic value as the present value of projected free cash flows plus a terminal value.

name: Unlevered free cash flow
summary: Cash flow available to all capital providers, before interest payments.

name: WACC
summary: Weighted average cost of capital; the discount rate for unlevered free cash flow.

name: Terminal value
summary: Value of cash flows beyond the projection period, via perpetuity growth or an exit multiple.

name: Capital structure
summary: The mix of debt and equity used to finance a company.

name: EV / EBITDA
summary: Capital-structure-neutral multiple comparing enterprise value with operating profit before D&A.

name: Leveraged buyout
summary: Acquisition funded largely with debt, repaid from the target's cash flows, to amplify equity returns.

name: IRR and MOIC
summary: IRR is the annualised return; MOIC is total cash returned divided by cash invested.

name: Accretion / dilution
summary: Whether a deal raises or lowers the acquirer's pro forma earnings per share.

name: Tax shield
summary: Reduction in taxes from tax-deductible expenses such as interest or depreciation.
